── NESSA'S WEEK ──
Nessa is 41 and new to running, aiming to run the whole Corrowmore Harvest 5K on 15 November without walking. Nessa walk-runs three mornings a week (Monday, Wednesday and Saturday) and walks the dog most days.
Recent weeks: 6.8, 7.3, 2.8, 7 km
This week: 0 km over 0 runs. Missed 3 of 3 planned runs.
Body: "All good."
Feeling: "Feeling great, excited for next week."

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Nessa: All three runs slipped last week with no note on what got in the way, so we pick up where the week of Sep 14…
What happened. You were set up for three walk-run sessions and ran none; Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday were planned rest and stayed rest.
Safety flag: Tell me if anything was off last week
Next week:
Mon: easy, walk-run 24 min, 8 x 2 min run and 1 min walk, easy breathing throughout…
Tue: rest. Let the legs settle after the first run back.
Wed: easy, walk-run 24 min, 8 x 2 min run and 1 min walk, same effort as Monday. Repeats…
Thu: rest. Dog walks are fine; no running.
Fri: rest. Keeps you fresh for the longer Saturday session.
Sat: easy, walk-run 24 min, 6 x 3 min run and 1 min walk, keep it conversational…
Sun: rest. Full day off to close the week.
